authorization_scope: One bounded 40x seed-0/fleet-0 legacy/physical pair following the retained 2.5x and 0.75x diagnostics; no seed expansion or E2.

predecessor.legacy_evidence_contract_assumption: The 40x legacy arm is retained as an explicitly non-work-conserving historical-control diagnostic. Its absent admission/rejection/work evidence will not be inferred or treated as zero.

research_basis.authoritative_definition: docs/evaluation/TrafficTwin_research_audit_reply_2026-08-07.md specifies 0.75x, 2.5x and 40x under legacy clamp/snapshot and sequential physical rejection/conservation.
research_basis.bounded_unit: The remaining seed-0 cap point is 40x. Both arms are new executions with identical actor, trace, evaluator seed, fleet seed, placement, scaling and task-stream configuration.
research_basis.hypothesis: At the high ceiling, physical RSU-cap rejection may fall while admitted queueing and penalty-inclusive latency may grow. Offered-task attainment may improve, tie or harm; no direction is accepted before validation.
not_answered_by_this_pair: a component-level clamp versus snapshot versus vehicle-queue ablation

explicitly_excluded: additional E1 cap or seed cells beyond this 40x seed-0/fleet-0 pair

vec_env.selection_reason: The same audited pinned evaluator used by E0 and the 2.5x/0.75x E1 pairs; both documented semantic paths are present and the worktree remains clean.

cap.name: per-RSU admission/in-flight task ceiling
cap.source: The research audit predeclares 40x; the pinned evaluator resolves int(round(ratio * padded fleet width)).

legacy.source_semantics: Surplus tasks remain scored while only the aggregate admitted fraction of batch work enters the backlog.

environment.sumo_execution_note: The evaluator replays the NPZ and does not invoke SUMO. This is not an exact canonical SUMO 1.27.0 reproduction.

smoke_commands: common_argv_prefix + legacy_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=10 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/legacy_smoke/run_1
common_argv_prefix + legacy_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=10 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/legacy_smoke/run_2
common_argv_prefix + physical_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=10 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/physical_smoke/run_1
common_argv_prefix + physical_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=10 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/physical_smoke/run_2
full_commands_in_order: common_argv_prefix + legacy_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=3600 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/legacy_full/run_1
common_argv_prefix + physical_semantic_argv + output_argv with MAX_STEPS=3600 and RUN_DIR=local-output:e1_outputs/e1-40x-semantics-pair-seed0-v1/physical_full/run_1

common_assertions: input hashes and predeclared configurations match
summary offered equals total tasks, per-step arrivals and active per-task records
per-step deadline-met equals active per-task met flags
Local + V2I + V2V action counts equal offered tasks
all numerical values are finite and nonnegative where physically required
offered-task completion and penalty-inclusive offered latency are recomputed
task-active masks and task types match exactly across arms
repeat_assertions: each arm's two 10-step scientific summaries are identical excluding wall time
each arm's two 10-step instrumentation array identities are identical
legacy_specific: admission, admitted completion, rejection and work fields remain null/unobservable
zero rejection placeholders are not interpreted as observed zero
legacy work conservation is not passed
physical_specific: offered equals admitted plus six terminal rejection/unavailability reasons
every active task has one outcome code 1..8
aggregate rejection reasons match outcome codes
V2I and vehicle work ledgers conserve milliseconds of service work
offered and admitted denominators remain separate

stop_conditions: either arm's repeated smoke differs scientifically or by instrumentation array identity
cross-arm task-active masks or task types differ
legacy full common reconciliation fails before the physical full run
physical full task/work conservation or terminal accounting fails
input identity or predeclared configuration differs
any output contains NaN, infinity, impossible negative values or silent task-record loss
limitations: Legacy clamp is a superseded non-work-conserving software path, not a physical system.
Legacy admitted, rejected and work-loss magnitudes are not emitted and remain unavailable.
The pair bundles snapshot/clamp/legacy versus sequential/reject/conserved semantics.
This is one cap and one seed pair; the three cap points together still provide no uncertainty analysis.
The 99520-task ceiling is a provisional pilot point, not an approved physical buffer and not compute power.
The UK-2030 fleet preset remains provisional pending the complete historical run contract.
Installed SUMO 1.27.1 differs from trace provenance 1.27.0.
No native physical completion or result-return events are observed.
